boot.evidence: Boot log reported HackyLens 0.3.0 full, modular firmware ready, and 12 applications after package flash and reboot.

buttons.evidence: Hardware input reported the canonical LEFT=1, OK=2, RIGHT=4, and BACK/LEARNING=8 masks during operator presses.

camera.evidence: OV2640 MID/PID 0x7FA2/0x2642 initialized at 640x480; a complete 614400-byte RGB565 frame was transferred and visually inspected.

display.evidence: ST7789-compatible 320x240 display initialized; a complete 230454-byte BMP screenshot was transferred and visually inspected.

external_links.evidence: Runtime switched the descriptor-owned IO34/IO35 routes UART-to-I2C-to-UART; the MicroPython external-UART binding transmitted a 17-byte smoke payload.
external_links.scope: runtime routing and transmit smoke; no external electrical loopback fixture

flash_package_round_trip.evidence: The release-qualified package image and matching schema-1 sidecar/attestation passed preflight, BootROM programming completed, and the board rebooted as firmware 0.3.0.

hmpy.evidence: HELLO reported protocol 1, firmware 0.3.0, canonical board identity, mounted USERFS, and capabilities 511; read-only probe, reversible workflow, cleanup, and lease reconnect passed without formatting USERFS.

lights.evidence: Operator observed illumination ON then OFF and the RGB red, green, blue, OFF sequence; firmware logs recorded both completion markers.

sd.evidence: Boot log reported SDHC initialization and FAT32 mount at LBA 8192 with 245984 clusters.

scope_limits: The selected ISP stub exposes no flash-read command, so --verify reported that readback was unavailable; package identity plus successful 0.3.0 boot provide the round-trip evidence.
External-link electrical RX/loopback qualification needs a separate fixture; this smoke covers descriptor routing, UART/I2C mode switching, and UART transmit.
Sipeed Maix Cube hardware qualification is outside the Phase 1 gate.
